thesis.title: MSc Computer Science — Artificial Intelligence
thesis.focus: Swarm optimization methods applied to high-dimensional search and robotic inverse kinematics
thesis.overview: Coursework and research in optimization and intelligent systems, alongside my full-time AI work at TCS Hungary.
objectives: Publish results that others can reproduce.
Test swarm optimization methods on practical problems like inverse kinematics.
Apply research evaluation methods to production retrieval systems.
thesis.progress: Co-authored Social Attraction PSO, published at ICCCI 2026 (Springer CCIS 3044). Thesis work is next.
thesis.currentDirection: Building on the published Social Attraction PSO work toward the thesis, with continued focus on swarm methods under real constraints such as joint limits in inverse kinematics.
